title: 5637.R1.P0 GRC1
growth_protocol_ch1: 5637 and Phase3, phase7, phase 15, gemcitabine-resistant 5637 bladder cancer cells were cultured in DMEM supplemented with 10% fetal bovine serum and 1% penicillin-streptomycin antibiotics solution. All of the cells were maintained at 37˚C with 5% CO2.
extract_protocol_ch1: RNA samples for sequencing were isolated using the Qiagen RNeasy Mini Kit (Qiagen, Hilden, Germany) according to the manufacturer’s protocol. Total RNA isolation was performed in a reverse transcription reaction with poly(dT) primers using PrimeScriptTM reverse transcriptase (TAKARA, Shiga, Japan) according to the manufacturer’s protocol. The library’s quality and quantity were measured by a Nanodrop spectrophotometer (ND-1000; Thermo Scientific, Waltham, MA, USA). | RNA libraries were prepared for sequencing using standard Illumina protocols.
data_processing: Reference genome indexing and read mapping of samples were performed using STAR software (ver. 2.6.1a). | FeatureCounsts (ver. 1.6.2) was used to calculate genereated binary alignment map (BAM) files. | The read counts per million fragments mapped (CPM) of each samples were used to estimate the expression level of each gene. | Assembly: GRCh38 | Supplementary files format and content: tab-delimited text files include CPM values for each Sample
